content: # Measurement Data for Thoria Fuel A comprehensive set of measurements was obtained for thoria (ThO2) samples. The lattice parameter is 5.5959 angstrom at room temperature. Thermal conductivity values: 12.0 W/(m K) at 300 K, 6.5 W/(m K) at 1000 K, and 4.0 W/(m K) at 1500 K. Density is 9.7 g/cm^3. The bulk modulus is 240 GPa. Shear modulus 103 GPa. Youngs modulus is 271 GPa. The melting point is 3663 K. Formation energy is -1226 kJ/mol.
